parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure the input length does not exceed the buffer size before sending it to the server.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now checks if the length of the input exceeds the buffer size (258 bytes) before sending it to the server. If the input is too large, the program will print an error message and prompt the user to enter a valid input.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now checks the length of the input and prevents sending it to the server if it exceeds the buffer size. This change ensures that the buffer overflow vulnerability is mitigated.
